Extract mu and tau-squared from a random-effects meta-analysis

Source: R/helpers-meta-analysis.R
rma_mu_tau.Rd

A tidier for fits from rma_helper(): mu is the average effect across studies and tau_sq the variance of the true effects across studies.

Usage

rma_mu_tau(fit)

Arguments

fit

A fit from rma_helper() or metafor::rma().

Value

A data frame with two rows, mu and tau_sq, with estimates, standard errors, and confidence intervals (for tau_sq, intervals only when method = "REML"). If the fit failed, one row with estimate = NA and error = TRUE.

Details

See https://book.declaredesign.org/complex-designs.html#meta-analysis

Examples


set.seed(343)
studies <- data.frame(
  est = rnorm(10, mean = 0.2, sd = 0.1),
  se = runif(10, min = 0.05, max = 0.15)
)
fit <- rma_helper(studies, yi = est, sei = se)
rma_mu_tau(fit)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   term   estimate std.error statistic      p.value conf.low conf.high
#>   <chr>     <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>        <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1 mu      0.138     0.0281       4.92  0.000000880   0.0832    0.194 
#> 2 tau_sq  0.00135   0.00350     NA    NA             0         0.0166
